description: Senior Frontend Engineer and Tech Lead with 9+ years building large-scale React and Vue.js applications — micro-frontend architecture, design systems, and frontend performance.

hero.intro: 9+ years shipping large-scale React and Vue.js applications for US retail and healthcare — micro-frontend architecture, design systems, and frontend performance. I lead frontend teams at Nisum and stay hands-on in architecture and code review.

paragraphs: I started as a UI developer turning high-fidelity designs into responsive pages with hand-written CSS, then moved into React product work — owning the frontend for Nextu, used by 100,000+ people, and building a startup’s first MVP end to end as its sole engineer.

At Nisum since 2021, I’ve built frontend platforms for a Fortune-500 US home and furnishings retailer: micro-frontend and mono-repo foundations, a shared component library, and a Backend-for-Frontend layer. I’ve led frontend teams the whole time, and as Tech Lead I now own estimation, solution design, and capacity planning across concurrent projects.
I’ve mentored 10+ engineers, three of whom were promoted, and I interview frontend candidates and run internal sessions on micro-frontend architecture and testing strategy.
about.focus: Micro-frontend architecture, design systems, Core Web Vitals and accessibility, testing strategy, AI-assisted workflows.

extraProjects.name: ShopByStyle
extraProjects.description: A fixed-bid e-commerce program built on runtime composition instead of a single SPA. I architected the mono-repo and micro-frontend foundation so independent teams could deploy without coordinated releases.

extraProjects.name: Company MVP
extraProjects.description: The company’s first product, delivered end to end as sole engineer — React frontend, Node/Express REST APIs, and MongoDB schema.

extraProjects.name: Nextu & Saaya Health
extraProjects.description: Responsive, cross-browser product interfaces — Nextu serving 100,000+ users globally. Owned the frontend and partnered with UI/UX on flow redesigns that lifted conversion 20%.
